dedupe_keys.name: bocra telecom statistics mobile fixed broadband and mobile money subscriptions in botswana

description: The Botswana Communications Regulatory Authority publishes telecom statistics on its website. The statistics page read on 2026-09-28 has sections on mobile money subscriptions, mobile broadband subscriptions, fixed broadband subscriptions, fixed telephony subscriptions, prepaid and postpaid telephony subscriptions and mobile telephony subscriptions, each given as at March 2024; the same site links the regulator's quality of service monitoring, radio spectrum planning and national radio frequency plan. Coverage is Botswana. Access is free on the web; no licence is stated. Caveats: the figures are shown as charts, so values and the series length were not read, and the latest period is March 2024. It supports capacity planning of telecom networks and of mobile money as a dependent service, such as sizing mobile broadband demand in a national model. No related Botswana telecom statistics record is catalogued.
name: BOCRA telecom statistics: mobile, fixed, broadband and mobile money subscriptions in Botswana
